crs_evidence: IATP source uses geographic admin bounds; its heatmap Shapefile export explicitly declares EPSG:4326. The heatmap API itself omits a CRS field.

mapping.lookup: floor normalized longitude and latitude; outer east/north edges excluded
mapping.source_calculation_anchor_note: The calculator evaluates np.arange(adminWest,adminEast,res) and np.arange(adminSouth,adminNorth,res), with no half-cell shift. The API display bounds use north-height*res for south. Original adminSouth is absent from this API, so do not claim display-cell centers are the original evaluation points. This export intentionally matches the software image overlay and floor hover lookup.
mapping.geotiff_note: If writing a conventional north-up GeoTIFF with this API Affine, flip the south-first array vertically before writing.

classification.intervals: [lower,upper), last interval inclusive of upper; value<=first bound uses first color; overflow uses last color, matching frontend

nodata.building_policy: keep real building geometry, budget_g/budget_color=null, budget_status=nodata
